speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry what are the further measures that the Government can consider to control or moderate the Consumer Price Index (CPI) after having taken into consideration the main components causing the rise in the CPI in the last two years.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: For middle-income households, the measures will substantially cover the increases in spending.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: As I highlighted to the House in February this year, the effects of MAS' past tightening moves are expected to continue to dampen inflation over the course of the year.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: Every public transport journey is subsidised by the Government.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: In fact, the Minister for Transport added that more than $1 for every public transport journey, subsidised.
